source.author: verg
source.text: Quinquaginta illi thalami, spes tanta nepotum, barbarico postes auro spoliisque superbi, procubuere; tenent Danai, qua deficit ignis.
source.text_original: Quinquaginta illi thalami, spes tanta nepotum, / barbarico postes auro spoliisque superbi, / procubuere; tenent Danai, qua deficit ignis.
source.text_english: Fifty bridal chambers, that great hope of descendants, their doorposts proud with barbaric gold and spoils, have fallen; the Greeks occupy them, where the fire is failing.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: mox Scythiae spoliis nuribusque superbus adveniet; cuperem ipse graves turn rumpere terras.
reuse.text_original: mox Scythiae spoliis nuribusque superbus / adveniet; cuperem ipse graves turn rumpere terras.
reuse.text_english: Soon he will arrive, proud with the spoils of Scythia and with brides; I should like then myself to burst the heavy earth.
